content:
Maya: Quick sync — finalizing the welcome + nurture drip that ties the benchmark webinar to the newsletter. Need: send windows, segments, subject variants, suppression rules, and tracking. Goal: webinar sign-ups -> trial starts (target 10% conversion).

Jon: Can we keep it lightweight — 3 subject lines, preview-text test, and timezone-staggering. Also exclude current trial users.

Priya: Drafted 3 clear subject options and preview text: 
- "See how inference costs drop 3x — live benchmark webinar"
- "Optimizing LLM inference: benchmark + live Q&A"
- "Reduce latency & cost: Redwood Inference benchmark (webinar)"
Preview: "Live demo + real-world cost/latency numbers. RSVP."

Jon: +1. We'll A/B subject and preview on a 10% holdout per region.

Aaron: Suggested cadence: Day 0 (welcome + webinar invite), Day 3 (teaser with one insight), Day 7 (formal invite + CTA), Day 10 (last chance). Stagger sends by region (NA/EU/APAC) to hit ~9am local.

Lina: Segment defs proposal: `signed_up_last_30d`, `trial=false`, `account_tier!=enterprise`, `region in [NA,EU,APAC]`. Also create a 10% holdout cohort for baseline metrics. Exclude tag:webinar_2025_02 (recent attendees).

Priya: Add tracking UTM string for links: `?utm_source=newsletter&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=benchmark_launch_v1`

Aaron: Ops notes: schedule in Customer.io (or Marketo if needed). I can own scheduling/export. Need CSV format: `email,region,variant,send_window`. Also use batch throttle of 2000/min to avoid warmup spikes.

Maya: Landing page & pixel — Lina, can you confirm UTM'd landing page + conversion pixel for `trial.started`? Also we want `newsletter.clicked` and `webinar.registered` events instrumented.

Lina: On it. I'll publish the UTM'd page and add GTM events for `newsletter.clicked` and `webinar.registered`. Will also confirm the trial conversion pixel and pass `account_id` for attribution.

Jon: Metrics to monitor post-send: open rate, CTR, webinar signups, webinar-to-trial conversion, downstream trial activation. We'll compare A vs B subjects and region splits.

Priya: Copy checklist: lead with outcome (cost/latency), short bullets (1–2), clear CTA button text `Register — Benchmark Webinar`, and social proof line (customer logo or quote). I pushed updated copy to this thread — will finalize by EOD.

Maya: Blockers? Copy + segments need to be locked by today 6pm PT so Aaron can schedule tomorrow AM.

Aaron: I'll queue once I get the final CSV and scheduled windows. Also note deliverability: remove recently bounced, throttle new domains, and apply warmup delays for small ISPs.

Jon: Small ask — exclude anyone who attended our last webinar (tag:webinar_2025_02). Priya, please update creative to reference fresh content.

Priya: Done — creative updated and subject lines posted above include that edit.

Maya: Great. Final checklist for deploy:
- Segments exported (Aaron)
- Copy locked (Priya)
- Landing + tracking live (Lina)
- Schedule + throttle set (Aaron)
- A/B split and holdout configured (Jon)

Aaron: Confirmed I'll do export + schedule. Will ping once scheduled. Batch size 2000/min. :thumbsup:

Maya: Thanks team — aiming for schedule tomorrow 9am PT for NA, EU send tomorrow 9am local, APAC follow next day. If anything slips, flag here. :rocket:
